title: Running tests in click (pytest/tox/uv)
answers: How do I run tests in click?
How to run a single test file?
What pytest config does click use?
How do I run stress or random-order tests?
body:
- Project uses uv + `uv.lock`; `[tool.uv] default-groups = [dev, pre-commit, tests, typing]` in pyproject.toml, so plain `uv sync` installs all.
- pytest config in `pyproject.toml` `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`: `testpaths=["tests"]`, `filterwarnings=["error"]` (any warning fails a test), `addopts="-m 'not stress'"` (stress tests skipped by default).
- Run: `uv run pytest`, `uv run pytest tests/test_options.py`, `uv run pytest tests/test_options.py::test_name -v`.
- tox (tox-uv) envs under `[tool.tox]` in pyproject.toml: `tox run -e py3.13 -- tests/test_options.py` (extra args after `--`); `tox r -e random` (pytest-randomly + xdist, `tests-random` group); `tox r -e stress` (overrides addopts, uses `-x`).
- CI: `.github/workflows/tests.yaml` runs `uv run --locked --no-default-groups --group dev tox run` over a Python matrix incl. PyPy 3.11.
- Note: derived from reading configs only; commands were not executed.
